name: ~Ii kara Choko o Nagero Hanashi wa Sore Kara da~
original_name: ～いいからチョコを投げろ話はそれからだ～
source:
The protagonist is the very person who accidentally blew up her own kitchen on the eve of Valentine's Day! 
Only one chocolate survived in her hands… 
Now, who should she gives it to…
[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/2909]Novelgame[/url]]
